# EzScout

> EzScout is a demo football-scouting site by Dawid Olko: scouting reports and match analysis, with data collected by hand and conclusions written by an analyst. It is a static site in English and Polish.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://ezscout.dawidolko.pl/): report types, how the process works, track record and contact form
- [Home (Polish)](https://ezscout.dawidolko.pl/pl/): the same page in Polish

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
